panels.title: Read the panels in this order

options.content:
**1 · Throughput** — is the system doing more or less work? Nothing below means anything without this.

**2 · AAS by wait class** — *why* it's doing that much. AAS = backends simultaneously busy. `CPU` near 12 (your cores) = saturated. `Lock` high while `CPU` is flat = contention, and no cache fixes it. `LWLock/WALInsert` climbing = you've hit Postgres's internal write serialization.

**3 · Waiting for the client** — if this is high, **your load generator is the bottleneck, not Postgres**, and every number on this page understates the database.

**4 · Blocked sessions / oldest txn** — non-zero blocked means row contention; a sawtooth in oldest txn means a batch job is holding locks across its whole runtime.

Rule of thumb: *throughput flat + CPU pinned* = capacity ceiling (scale up). *throughput flat or falling + CPU idle* = contention or an upstream limit (scaling up does nothing).

panels.title: 1 · Throughput (commits/sec)
panels.description: From pg_stat_database deltas, sampled at 1 Hz. Should match pgbench's reported tps.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS "time", 'commits/s' AS metric,
       max(commits_per_s) AS value
FROM ash.tps WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND commits_per_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval), 'rollbacks/s', max(rollbacks_per_s)
FROM ash.tps WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rollbacks_per_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 2 · Average Active Sessions by wait class
panels.description: Stacked height = total DB concurrency. Dashed line = your 12 cores.

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS t, count(DISTINCT ts) AS samples
  FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT n.t AS "time", CASE WHEN s.wait_event_type IS NULL THEN 'CPU' ELSE s.wait_event_type END AS metric,
       count(*)::float / max(n.samples) AS value
FROM ash.samples s
JOIN n ON n.t = $__timeGroup(s.ts, $__interval)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) 
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 3 · DB time spent waiting for the client
panels.description: ClientRead: the backend finished and is idle waiting for the next statement. High here means the generator, not the database, set your numbers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS "time",
       'DB time spent waiting for the client' AS metric,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event = 'ClientRead')
            / nullif(count(*), 0) AS value
FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wait events in detail
panels.description: LWLock/WALInsert = WAL insertion serialization. LWLock/XidGen = txn-id assignment. Lock/transactionid = waiting on a row another transaction wrote.

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS t, count(DISTINCT ts) AS samples
  FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT n.t AS "time", coalesce(s.wait_event_type,'CPU') || ' / ' || coalesce(s.wait_event,'on-cpu') AS metric,
       count(*)::float / max(n.samples) AS value
FROM ash.samples s
JOIN n ON n.t = $__timeGroup(s.ts, $__interval)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) 
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 4 · Sessions blocked by another session
panels.description: Non-zero means lock contention, full stop.

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS t, count(DISTINCT ts) AS samples
  FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT n.t AS "time", 'sessions blocked' AS metric,
       count(*)::float / max(n.samples) AS value
FROM ash.samples s
JOIN n ON n.t = $__timeGroup(s.ts, $__interval)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.blocking_pids IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: WAL write volume
panels.description: MB/s of WAL generated. Two UPDATEs per transaction cost roughly twice the WAL of one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS "time", 'WAL MB/s' AS metric,
       max(wal_mb_per_s) AS value
FROM ash.tps WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wal_mb_per_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Oldest open transaction
panels.description: Batch jobs and idle-in-transaction appear here as a sawtooth.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS "time", 'oldest open txn' AS metric,
       max(xact_age_ms) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active sessions by scenario (application_name)
panels.description: run.sh and mix.sh set PGAPPNAME, so mixed runs stay attributable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS t, count(DISTINCT ts) AS samples
  FROM ash.samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT n.t AS "time", coalesce(nullif(s.application_name,''),'(unnamed)') AS metric,
       count(*)::float / max(n.samples) AS value
FROM ash.samples s
JOIN n ON n.t = $__timeGroup(s.ts, $__interval)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) 
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
